# Steelage Construction Ltd

> Leading Commercial General Contractor in Surrey, BC & Metro Vancouver

## Company Overview
- **Company Name**: Steelage Construction Ltd
- **Headquarters**: 8333 130 St #11, Surrey, BC V3W 7X4, Canada
- **Phone**: (604) 418-1515
- **Email**: info@steelage.ca
- **Website**: https://steelage.ca
- **Business Type**: Commercial General Contractor & Construction Management
- **Service Regions**: Surrey, Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Langley, Delta, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Maple Ridge, and Victoria / Vancouver Island.

## Core Commercial Services
1. **Commercial General Contracting & Ground-Up Construction**: Full-scale commercial buildings, structural steel, building envelopes, civil site work, and municipal permitting across Surrey and Metro Vancouver.
2. **Commercial Tenant Improvements**: Custom leasehold fit-outs, spatial reconfigurations, MEP upgrades, retail storefronts, corporate offices, daycare centres, and medical/dental clinics.
3. **Restaurant & Hospitality Construction**: Turnkey commercial kitchen build-outs, grease interceptors, high-CFM exhaust hoods, NFPA 96 fire suppression, bars, and Fraser Health code compliance.
4. **Franchise Restaurant & Retail Builds**: Strict franchisor brand manual compliance and expedited openings for national brands including Boston Pizza, Dairy Queen Grill & Chill, Mucho Burrito, and Oakberry Açaí.

## Key Projects
- **Boston Pizza**: Freestanding commercial restaurant & sports lounge build in British Columbia.
- **Dairy Queen Grill & Chill**: Standalone quick-service restaurant with drive-thru in Surrey, BC.
- **Mucho Burrito**: Commercial tenant improvement & restaurant build-out in Surrey, BC.
- **Oakberry Açaí**: Specialized retail fit-out & custom millwork in Surrey, BC.
- **BMPP Commercial Exterior**: Ground-up building envelope and structural facade modernization.
